tools.name: documents_list
tools.description: List documents in the local Matcha Office library. Returns id, name, type, size, revision and timestamps. Use document_read for content.

tools.name: document_create
tools.description: Create a library document. docx source is Markdown or restricted HTML; xlsx is workbook JSON or CSV; csv preserves native CSV source text; pptx is deck spec JSON or ops JSON; md/html/txt/json is source text. pdf creates a blank A4 page and requires no source; import or convert for existing content.

resources.description: Markdown/HTML document resources, with canonical relative paths and base64 bytes. Omit to preserve existing resources; [] clears them. Commits atomically with the body.

tools.name: document_import
tools.description: Import document bytes into the library. Native .docx/.xlsx/.xlsm/.pptx/.pdf/.md/.html/.txt/.json are preserved; supported legacy Word/HWP/ODF, spreadsheet and presentation formats are converted by the original engines and return conversion details. data is canonical base64, not a data URL. Native .csv files keep their original bytes, name and CSV identity; importing CSV does not convert it to XLSX.

resources.description: Markdown/HTML document resources, with canonical relative paths and base64 bytes. Omit to preserve existing resources; [] clears them. Commits atomically with the body.

tools.name: document_write
tools.description: Replace a document's bytes at expectedRevision. Used by the Matcha Office editor when it saves. Revision conflicts never overwrite newer edits.

resources.description: Markdown/HTML document resources, with canonical relative paths and base64 bytes. Omit to preserve existing resources; [] clears them. Commits atomically with the body.

tools.name: document_read
tools.description: Read a document and return a preview. docx returns restricted document HTML and block indexes. xlsx returns a cell grid and formulas. pptx returns slides and element geometry. pdf returns page text. md/html/txt/json returns text. CSV uses the Sheets reader and retains document.type=csv.

tools.name: document_edit
tools.description: Apply GenOffice ops or sheet cells at expectedRevision, or replace Markdown/HTML/TXT/JSON with source text. Revision conflicts never overwrite newer edits. Use document_guide for op syntax. Native CSV accepts literal cells only (cell, value, optional sheet=Sheet1), not formulas, styles or ops. CSV import preserves formula-like source text as literal cells; convert to XLSX for formula or structural editing.

pdf.description: GenOffice PDF SavePdfRequest editing fields, excluding path and targetPath. Redactions create a clean copy and leave the source unchanged.

resources.description: Markdown/HTML document resources, with canonical relative paths and base64 bytes. Omit to preserve existing resources; [] clears them. Commits atomically with the body.

tools.name: document_check
tools.description: Run GenOffice document, workbook or deck checks and return warnings and errors. docx uses docs check, xlsx uses sheet check, pptx uses slides audit. CSV is checked with the Sheets algorithms without replacing its native bytes.

tools.name: document_export
tools.description: Return a document's original bytes, or convert docx to Markdown / xlsx to CSV, as canonical base64. Use the Matcha Office UI for large downloads. CSV original/csv export preserves native source bytes.

tools.name: document_delete
tools.description: Delete a document from the local Matcha Office library. This is irreversible.

tools.name: document_guide
tools.description: Return the GenOffice op guide for docs, sheets or slides. The guide lists every supported op, its fields and examples.

tools.name: document_convert
tools.description: Convert a library document to another supported format and create a new library document, leaving the source unchanged. Returns source, document and warnings. Availability follows the original format engines. Native CSV supports conversion to XLSX or PDF; XLSX to CSV exports one selected sheet and returns data-loss warnings.

tools.name: document_render
tools.description: Render a library document to PNG page images. page is 1-based; omit it to render all pages. Returns document and images with page, width, height, mimeType and base64 data. CSV is rendered through the Sheets layout pipeline.

tools.name: document_html_action
tools.description: Use the original HTML editor document tools on the exact document already open in its application page. context returns the redacted current context; get_outline and read_source expose stable element IDs and source; apply_ops applies validated edits with the original undo and dirty lifecycle; pin_brief updates the embedded design brief. Open the document first. Unavailable when its editor is not open; navigation acknowledgement alone does not prove it is ready.

tools.name: document_sheets_action
tools.description: Use the original Sheets document tools on the exact workbook already open in its application page. Includes workbook context, ranges, aggregation, formats, features, cell search, selection, formula tracing, operation proposals, guide lookup and document creation. Actions preserve native validation, undo, dirty and save lifecycle. Unavailable without a matching editor; navigation acknowledgement alone does not prove readiness.

tools.name: document_slides_action
tools.description: Use the original Slides document algorithms on the exact presentation already open in its application page. execute_slide_script (execute_layout_script alias) edits live page elements atomically with one undo step; insert_web_image and replace_image use remote image URLs with original frame/crop semantics. Uses the current editor geometry, history, dirty state and normal save lifecycle. Open the document first; navigation acknowledgement alone does not prove readiness. Does not run a model or image-generation provider.
